_doc: Beacon worlds (planet 1 of Fomalhaut, Pollux, Arcturus, Capella) hold a dormant monolith on a stone plaza, guarded by a sleeping keeper. Wake it, beat it, and the beacon lights for good (planet_states.data.beacon) and drops the family's first Spark. guardian: hp (kidHp in kid mode), walking speeds, wakeRange = how close you must come to wake it, senseRange = how far it chases, charge = a telegraphed rush that stuns it against a wall (stunDamageScale = damage multiplier while stunned), slam = a jump whose landing hurts within slamRadius. knockbackScale: how much your hits push it (it is heavy). spark: pickup timing. beacon: plaza size in tiles and how far from the base it is placed.

lattice._doc: The beacons were placed along four symmetric directions around the Sun. Each lit one joins a lattice drawn on the star map (lines to the Sun and between lit beacons); letters between two settled systems that are both within radius light years of a lit beacon (or of the Sun, once any beacon is lit) arrive at once; with all four lit every letter does (the FTL comms of the backlog, earned instead of built).
